name: Consalvo Sanesi
features: olive skin, dark hair swept back, dark eyes, lean weathered face, deep-set lines, wiry build, reserved unsmiling expression, soft leather helmet with goggles pushed up on the brow
bio: Alfa Romeo's chief test driver, and the only man on the 158 team who had built the car as well as driven it. Joined Alfa as a mechanic at fifteen and spent thirty years there, testing everything the factory made and racing the Alfetta when the works needed a fourth car. Never a full works number one, but the man who knew what the 158 would do before anybody sat in it.
